baseline.metric: best EMA P1 within first 80 epochs with same-checkpoint P2

accepted_risks: A1 has fewer parameters because graph removal is not capacity compensated

experiments.budget: existing 120 epochs; selected epoch 60 lies within first 80

experiments.delta: graph_injection_mode=none; graph removed; no capacity compensation
experiments.acceptance: valid complete run; metric interpreted without threshold tuning
experiments.falsification: A1 fails to improve over A0
experiments.stopping_rule: stop only on invalid execution; A2 still follows any valid metric result

experiments.hypothesis: Topology-conditioned control is better than ordinary graph feature fusion.
experiments.delta: graph_injection_mode=feature; recurrent content and Delta/B/C both use X+G
experiments.acceptance: valid complete run; compare directly with A3
experiments.falsification: A2 equals or improves on A3

experiments.budget: existing 120 epochs; selected epoch 53 lies within first 80
experiments.acceptance: pre-change compatibility and strict checkpoint replay

experiments.name: Graph-Conditioned SSM w/o Factorization
experiments.hypothesis: Boundary-preserving factorization improves accuracy over coupled PoseMamba-style state propagation under identical graph-conditioned selective dynamics.
experiments.delta: factorized_spatial_temporal=false; both branches use existing BiSTSSM v2_plus_poselimbs on full [B,T,J,C]
experiments.controls: all A3 architecture, topology, optimizer, EMA, data, augmentation, and loss settings remain frozen
experiments.acceptance: all four regression gates pass and user confirms the 13-item preflight report
experiments.falsification: A4 equals or improves on A3
experiments.stopping_rule: do not launch before A1/A2 completion, preflight pass, and explicit user approval

decisions.decision: Run only A1 and A2, serially, for 80 epochs each.
decisions.evidence: User-overridden budget; A0/A3 best epochs are already within the first-80 window.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: No scale, graph, d-state, symmetry, loss, LR, robustness, MPI or multi-seed expansion in this phase.

decisions.decision: Pass the audit gate and authorize the serial A1-to-A2 queue.
decisions.evidence: 22/22 tests pass; A1/A2 have complete finite gradients and real-data smoke; explicit control reproduces the pre-change Full output with max_abs_error=0.0.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not add any unregistered ablation or start A2 before valid A1 completion.

decisions.decision: Start the fail-closed serial queue with A1; keep A2 queued behind A1 completion and strict verification.
decisions.evidence: GPU idle at launch; queue PID 135536; A1 PID 135551 entered epoch 1 at about 27.85 it/s and 2,890 MiB process memory.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: No parallel A1/A2 execution and no automatic resume of failed runs.

decisions.decision: Register Graph-Conditioned SSM w/o Factorization at an 80-epoch budget, but do not add it to the active A1/A2 queue before review.
decisions.evidence: The user explicitly overrode the pasted 60-epoch draft with an 80-epoch requirement; the draft requires a 13-item preflight review before long training.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not replace the block with PoseMamba, do not compensate parameter count, and do not auto-launch from implementation alone.

decisions.decision: Keep A1/A2 as valid ablation evidence, retain A3 Full, and reject ordinary graph feature fusion as the final design.
decisions.evidence: A1 is 40.0605/33.3565 mm; equal-parameter A2 is 40.0588/33.2873 mm; A3 Full remains better at 39.8452/33.2322 mm. Both new runs completed 80 epochs and strict raw/EMA replay passed.
decisions.rejected_alternatives: Do not promote the statistically negligible A2-vs-A1 P1 difference or select A2's P2 independently of its P1-selected checkpoint.
